福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

府城四大月老The Four Yuelao of Tainan

府城有四位月老，像專科醫師一樣各有專長：一位說媒、一位加溫、一位打爛桃花、一位幫你和好。認識四座廟和拜月老的習俗。

Tainan has four Yuelao, and like good specialists, each handles a different case. Meet all four and learn the customs.

臺南不只一位月老，而是有四位有名的月老，而且各有專長。月下老人用紅線綁住有緣人。信眾參拜、擲筊，心願成真後再帶喜餅回來答謝。第一位是建於 1678 年的大觀音亭的說媒型月老，闊嘴能言，最會替單身的人牽線。已經在交往了？大天后宮的加溫型月老替感情升溫，女生還能領紅線加緣粉。祀典武廟的執法型月老和關公一樣正氣凜然，用拐杖打跑爛桃花。最後是重慶寺的和事佬型月老，守著一甕醋：順時針攪求長長久久，逆時針攪求回心轉意。

Tainan has not one but four famous Yuelao, the old matchmaker gods, and each one has a different specialty. Yuelao, the Old Man under the Moon, ties a red thread between people who are meant to be together. Visitors pray, cast moon blocks, and later return with wedding cakes. First comes the Talker at the Grand Guanyin Pavilion, built in 1678. With his wide mouth, he is a born matchmaker for single people. Already dating? The Accelerator at the Grand Matsu Temple warms things up. Women may take fate powder along with a red thread. At the Martial Temple, the Enforcer is as stern as his boss, Guan Gong. With his cane, he chases away rotten peach blossoms. Finally, the Peacemaker at Chongqing Temple keeps an urn of vinegar. Couples stir it clockwise for a lasting bond, or counterclockwise to win someone back.

  2. 四位月老的分工同一份工作，四種脾氣：拜對月老很重要。Same job, four temperaments. Choose your Yuelao wisely.

認識景點

About the place

認識月老Meet Yuelao

月下老人：月老全名「月下老人」，傳說他用紅線把注定在一起的兩個人綁在一起。 先拜主神：到廟裡要先拜主神，再去拜月老。 說清楚你是誰：向月老說出姓名、生日、住址，還有理想對象的樣子。 擲筊：擲出一正一反的「聖筊」，代表月老答應，才能領紅線。

The Old Man under the Moon: Legend says Yuelao ties a red thread around two people who are meant to be together. Main god first: Pray to the temple's main god first, then visit Yuelao. Tell him who you are: Tell him your name, birthday and address, and the kind of partner you hope for. moon blocks: One flat side up and one round side up means yes, so you may take a red thread.

帶喜餅還願：心願成真的人，常帶喜餅回來答謝月老。

Thank-you wedding cakes: When wishes come true, couples often bring wedding cakes back to say thank you.

四位月老的分工Four specialists

一號：說媒型：大觀音亭的「闊嘴月老」嘴巴最大，能言善道，最會替單身的人說媒。 二號：加溫型：大天后宮的「緣粉月老」專替已經有對象的人加溫。男生領紅線，女生領紅線加緣粉。 三號：執法型：祀典武廟的「拐杖月老」和上司關公一樣正氣凜然，用拐杖打跑爛桃花和不忠的感情。 四號：和事佬型：重慶寺的「醋矸月老」前有一甕醋和攪拌杓。吵架、冷戰或想挽回的人，來這裡輕輕攪一攪。

No. 1: the Talker: The Wide-Mouthed Yuelao at the Grand Guanyin Pavilion is a born matchmaker for single people. No. 2: the Accelerator: The Fate-Powder Yuelao at the Grand Matsu Temple warms up a love that has already begun. Women also get fate powder. No. 3: the Enforcer: The Cane Yuelao at the Martial Temple is as stern as his boss, Guan Gong. He chases away bad romance with his cane. No. 4: the Peacemaker: The Vinegar-Jar Yuelao at Chongqing Temple has an urn of vinegar. Couples who quarrel come to stir it and make up.

順時針還是逆時針？：順時針攪三圈，求感情穩定、百年好合；逆時針攪三圈，求對方回心轉意。別攪錯方向！

Which way to stir?: Three circles clockwise for a steady bond. Three circles counterclockwise to win someone back. Don't mix them up!

四座廟走一圈Visiting the four temples

大觀音亭：1678 年明鄭時期興建，是臺灣最早的觀音廟之一，位在北區成功路，和主祀保生大帝的興濟宮並肩而立。 大天后宮後方：在媽祖廟的後方，月老和土地公同祀，求緣的人會帶走紅線和緣粉。 武廟的對聯：武廟月老旁的對聯祝願「天下有情人終成眷屬」，也希望成了家的人永遠相愛。 來自日本的信：疫情期間，一位日本信徒每兩週寄信給武廟月老，廟方回信附上紅線和緣粉。

Grand Guanyin Pavilion: Built in 1678, it is one of Taiwan's oldest Guanyin temples. It stands beside Xingji Temple, home of the god of medicine. Behind Mazu's hall: Yuelao shares a shrine with Tudigong, the Earth God. A wish for every couple: A couplet by his shrine wishes that all lovers become family, and that every family stays in love. Letters from Japan: During the pandemic, a man in Japan wrote to the Martial Temple's Yuelao every two weeks.

文學館後的重慶寺：主祀觀音的小寺，藏在臺灣文學館後方巷子裡，是府城「七寺八廟」之一。醋矸放在速報司神案前，攪醋的習俗相傳從清代流傳至今。

Chongqing Temple: This small Guanyin temple hides in an alley behind the Literature Museum. The vinegar urn sits before the Deity of Swift Reports.

實景照片

Photos on site

大天后宮的月老 Yuelao at the Grand Matsu Temple

大天后宮的月老神龕在鐵欄杆後面，供桌上寫著「月老尊神」和「福德正神」：月老和土地公在這裡一起接受祭拜。

At the Grand Matsu Temple, Yuelao's shrine stands behind an iron gate. He shares it with Tudigong, the Earth God.

許願閣與還願閣 Walls of wishes

月老旁邊的牆上掛滿心形卡片。「許願閣」是掛卡片許下姻緣願望的地方；「還願閣」是願望實現後，回來掛卡片感謝月老的地方。

Next to Yuelao, heart-shaped cards cover the wall. People hang a card here to make a wish for love. When the wish comes true, they come back and hang a card to say thank you.

重慶寺的主神龕 The main altar at Chongqing Temple

重慶寺主祀觀音。月老就供在主神龕上，神像前立著「月老公」的小牌子。

Chongqing Temple's main deity is Guanyin. Its Yuelao sits on the main altar too, with a small name sign in front of him.

重慶寺的醋矸 The vinegar urn at Chongqing Temple

重慶寺的醋矸放在速報司神案前，缸裡插著攪拌杓。相傳吵架或冷戰的人來這裡輕輕攪一攪：順時針求長長久久，逆時針求回心轉意。

At Chongqing Temple, the vinegar urn sits before the Deity of Swift Reports, with a stirring spoon inside. Legend says couples who quarrel come to stir it: clockwise for a lasting bond, counterclockwise to win someone back.
